name: JD Parser & Coverage Planner
_comment_depends_on: Nothing here is required to START. Every upstream is optional at runtime,
and its absence removes a FEATURE, never the endpoint and never silently.
`on_missing` is shown to a student: write a sentence they can act on.
A missing `base_url` is not a safe default - it silently disables the
upstream even when it IS running, so every entry carries one.
Override any base_url without editing this file: M04_BASE_URL=http://...

depends_on.name: Skill Graph & MNEMOS Memory
depends_on.reason: the concept ontology to scan a JD against, label resolution, and candidate mastery for the coverage gap
depends_on.on_missing: Your gaps against this JD — needs M04 Skill Graph. We still read the requirements out of the JD; we just can't say yet which of them you're weak on.

depends_on.name: Resume Ingestion & Claim Extraction
depends_on.reason: the student's resume, to check the eligibility bar against their actual CGPA (FR-2.15) and to say which requirements their resume evidences
depends_on.on_missing: Your resume against this job - needs M01 Resume Ingestion. We can still show what the posting asks for and where you stand against the Skill Graph; we just can't tell you whether you clear the CGPA cutoff or which requirements your resume actually mentions.

depends_on.name: Company Guider
depends_on.reason: company alias resolution, the drive variant this posting is for, and the topics students report being asked at this company (FR-2.13)
depends_on.on_missing: What this company actually asks - needs M15 Company Guider. We can still read the posting and plan your questions from it; we just can't tell you what students who sat this drive reported, or check the posting's package and bond against them.

_comment_planned: Spec §7 and the header also name M01 (resume claims, to weight a
requirement by what the student has actually done) and M15 (§6.7 company
enrichment - real round structure overriding archetype defaults).
Neither is consumed by this code yet, so neither is declared: a dependency
listed here produces a degradation banner, and a banner for a feature that
does not exist is the same lie in the other direction.
Add the entry in the same commit that adds the call.
_comment_feeds: These consume M02. They are NOT dependencies - M02 never calls them - but
the RequirementSet and CoveragePlan shapes are what they read.
Additive changes are safe; renaming or removing a field breaks them.

feeds.takes: requirement -> concept mapping, to select questions that probe a requirement
the coverage plan: question budget per requirement, round mix
role archetype and coverage plan for drive-variant matching
the gap list, as the study plan's input
the coverage ledger, for the post-session coverage report
